camel_example: aliyun adcp DetachClusterFromHub --region cn-hangzhou --ClusterId cb09fda0dc2f94a8397c76638c7ec0000 --ClusterIds c1c731554c1ec4a1ca9bb690ff9ed0000
description_en: Removes an ACK child cluster from an ACK One fleet instance
description_zh: 从ACK One舰队Fleet实例中移除ACK子集群
kebab_example: aliyun adcp detach-cluster-from-hub --cluster-id cb09fda0dc2f94a8397c76638c7ec0000 --cluster-ids c1c731554c1ec4a1ca9bb690ff9ed0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachClusterFromHub

parameters.help_en: The fleet ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424404.html operation to obtain the IDs of created fleet instances
parameters.help_zh: 舰队ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424404.html接口获取已创建的舰队Fleet实例
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The array of IDs for the child clusters to remove from the fleet. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424408.html operation to obtain the IDs of child clusters that are added to the fleet.

The value is a JSON string that can be parsed into a string array
parameters.help_zh:
从舰队中待移除的子集群ID数组。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424408.html接口获取主集群下已添加的子集群ID。

取值格式为JSON格式的字符串，可以被解析为一个字符串数组
parameters.name: cluster_ids

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove the child cluster only from the Service Mesh (ASM) instance.

true: Removes the child cluster only from the ASM instance.

false: Removes the child cluster from both the ASM instance and ACK One.

If this parameter is not set, the default value is false. The child cluster is removed from both the ASM instance and ACK One
parameters.help_zh:
是否仅从服务网格（ASM）中移除子集群。
true：仅从服务网格（ASM）移除子集群。
false：同时从服务网格（ASM）和ACK One中移除子集群。

若该参数未设置，默认按照取值为false处理，即默认子集群同时从服务网格（ASM）和ACK One中移除
parameters.name: detach_from_mesh

items.description_en: The ID of the child cluster
